system.description:
The microbots in this swarm communicate by microwave signals. Their effective communication range remains 50 meters within standard atmospheres, 200 meters in vacuum. This makes the swarm immune to radio-frequency jamming, but they can be jammed in a similar manner with a microwave link or radar device. Swarms using microwave links are more detectable (+30 to spot) to anything equipped with radar.

Source: Eclipse Phase Transhuman, p. 214.
